Cihon has spent decades working with people. As an athlete, coach to world-class champions, judge and educator.

Jacob is one of us. He knows the weight of expectations. And what it feels like to lose your sense of control over your own life.

His experience in sports, and a need he saw in the people around him, became the starting point for FLO and iU.

His mission? Helping everyday achievers hear themselves in the noise.

Experience built over years. A purpose that keeps evolving.

For more than two decades, Jacob Cihon has worked in human performance as an athlete, a coach to world-class champions, a judge and an educator.

A graduate of the University of Physical Education in Warsaw, where he studied sports management, Jacob became the first Polish judge in the IFBB Professional League and the NPC.

His experience spans European and American bodybuilding. He worked with Paweł Filleborn, then Vice President of the European Bodybuilding and Fitness Federation, and later with renowned bodybuilding coach George Farah.

Sharing knowledge has been a constant throughout his career. As an educator and organiser with PZKFiTS, Jacob brought people together to learn about training, nutrition and stage presentation. He organised Poland’s first posing workshops for Bikini Fitness and Men’s Physique, the country’s first lectures on preparing athletes for competition on a plant-based diet, and specialist courses on training methods for elite athletes.

Today, that experience serves a broader purpose.

Through the CIHON®Operating Human System, Jacob is creating tools that connect how we think, how we feel and how we care for our bodies. FLO and iU are the first expressions of that vision. They offer practical support for becoming more aware of what you need and acting on your own terms in everyday life.

The ambition keeps growing.
So does the understanding of what matters.
